subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should agentDir permanently become a second bootstrap-instruction authority, or should OpenClaw preserve workspace-only loading and warn users about misplaced bootstrap files?
rationale: The patch changes a documented storage and security boundary; implementation review alone cannot determine whether private runtime state should control prompt instructions.

options.title: Preserve workspace authority
options.body: Keep bootstrap loading workspace-only, use per-agent workspaces for customization, and add a clear warning for misplaced agentDir files.

options.title: Adopt agentDir overrides
options.body: Approve agentDir as a documented second instruction source and require explicit precedence, migration, isolation, and live upgrade proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve workspace authority
recommendation.body: Keep bootstrap loading workspace-only, use per-agent workspaces for customization, and add a clear warning for misplaced agentDir files.

likelyOwner.reason: The original workspace/bootstrap design history makes this person the strongest available owner for the authority decision.
